parsed_output.analysis: The specification describes PumpControl as a composite state with three directly nested, mutually exclusive substates PumpState, WaterState and MethaneState, with an initial entry into PumpState and later conditional moves to the other two substates from PumpControl. The PlantUML model makes PumpControl contain three orthogonal regions PumpRegion, WaterRegion and MethaneRegion, each with its own initial pseudo-state to PumpState/WaterState/MethaneState. This introduces extra intermediate states, creates concurrent activation of all three substates on entry to PumpControl, and provides no transitions from PumpControl to the substates and no conditions for moving between them.

issues.issue: Substates are not direct children of PumpControl; intermediate regions are introduced
issues.reason: Specification says within PumpControl there are three main substates: PumpState, WaterState and MethaneState. The model nests PumpState inside PumpRegion, WaterState inside WaterRegion and MethaneState inside MethaneRegion, so the direct substates of PumpControl are PumpRegion/WaterRegion/MethaneRegion, not the three named substates.
issues.where: state PumpControl { state PumpRegion { ... } state WaterRegion { ... } state MethaneRegion { ... } }

issues.issue: No transition from PumpControl to its substates and no conditional transitions
issues.reason: Specification requires PumpControl to be able to transition to different substates based on specific conditions. The model contains no transitions out of PumpControl to PumpState/WaterState/MethaneState and no guards/conditions on any transition.

issues.issue: Initial behaviour is concurrent entry to all three substates instead of first entering PumpState
issues.reason: Specification states the system first transitions to the PumpState substate. The model defines three orthogonal regions each with its own [*] --> ... initial, so entering PumpControl starts PumpState, WaterState and MethaneState simultaneously rather than sequentially with PumpState first.
issues.where: state PumpRegion { [*] --> PumpState }, state WaterRegion { [*] --> WaterState }, state MethaneRegion { [*] --> MethaneState }

issues.issue: Missing explicit first transition to PumpState from PumpControl
issues.reason: Specification says system begins in PumpControl and then first transitions to PumpState. The model has [*] --> PumpControl but no transition from PumpControl to PumpState; PumpState is only reachable as the initial of its own region.

system_prompt:
You are an experienced control-systems engineer reviewing a state machine model against the natural-language specification it was built from.

You are given two things, both complete and unmodified:
  1. The natural-language specification.
  2. A state machine model written in PlantUML.

Your task: identify the places where the model does not conform to the specification. Read the specification in full first, then read the model in full, then report what you find.

Report as many or as few issues as you actually find, and organize them however you judge best. For each issue, state what the non-conformance is, which part of the model it concerns, and why you consider it a non-conformance.

Write your findings in en-US. Return only the requested structured response.
